items.name: Thinking Machines Inkling 2 Mini
items.plain: A capable open AI model that runs on ordinary business laptops, so teams can experiment and build with it without paying for cloud compute.
items.summary: Thinking Machines Lab released Inkling 2 Mini on 20 November 2026, an open-weights multimodal model whose middle layers loop at inference time, squeezing stronger reasoning out of only 3.4B active parameters — small enough to run on a laptop. It is a research release, not tuned for production use.

items.name: Tencent Hy4 open weights
items.plain: One of the largest open AI models is now downloadable, giving teams that run their own infrastructure a top-tier model without depending on a vendor's cloud.
items.summary: Tencent published the full weights of Hy4, its 770B-parameter flagship multimodal model, on 20 November 2026 — the instruct model plus an FP8 build and a pretrained base — on Hugging Face, ModelScope and GitCode, fulfilling the open-weight pledge from its 4 November launch.

items.name: NVIDIA Nemotron-Labs-Sigma
items.plain: A faster way to generate text from AI models, cutting response times and compute costs for teams that run their own models.
items.summary: NVIDIA released Nemotron-Labs-Sigma on 20 November 2026, a family of 14 open checkpoints at 3B and 8B scale built on continuous diffusion instead of next-token prediction, which NVIDIA says decodes up to 4.2x faster than standard autoregressive models.

items.name: Snowflake Decision
items.plain: Lets business teams score and sort huge volumes of data, like support tickets, directly inside their data warehouse without moving data or building custom models.
items.summary: Snowflake put its Decision model into public preview on 20 November 2026: a purpose-built model for high-throughput classification, scoring and decision-making on massive datasets, called directly from SQL through Cortex AI_COMPLETE without moving data out of the warehouse.

items.name: K2-Horizon
items.plain: A full family of open AI models published with their training data and methods, so teams can inspect, adapt and run them on their own terms.
items.summary: IFM released K2-Horizon on 15–17 November 2026, a fleet of six open models from a 0.9B dense checkpoint to a 375B-A23B mixture-of-experts, published with training data, intermediate checkpoints and the pipelines behind them — a full technical report followed on arXiv (2611.21003).
